description: Sends a tested version (versionId) to Gamealia's review: a person checks every version before it goes live. For a mobile listing pass game instead (no versionId, no upload): it submits the current draft (texts, ageRating, cover, thumbnail and at least one store link are required). Submitting is the developer's decision. Updates to a live game or listing need release notes (notes).

game.description: Mobile listings: the game's slug or id (instead of versionId)

notes.description: Release notes: a short changelog of this version, in plain words for players. Required (at least 10 characters) to submit an update to a game that is already live

versionId.description: Version id (from start_upload, get_game or get_version_status)

name: submit_for_review
title: Submit for review
